route_terms.scholar_envoy: Pay travel, board and finite instruction by a competent practitioner; local staff repeat the relevant site assessment, model or qualified operation.
route_terms.partnership: Contribute actual observations, samples, staff, equipment time or funds; shared evidence still needs local interpretation and compatible site conditions.
route_terms.purchased_research: Commission a defined water or ecological question from a capable source; pay for evidence and local evaluation without a guaranteed favorable or transferable result.
route_terms.licensed_or_imported_service: Pay for a real bounded treatment, measurement or field service within the provider's reachable capacity; continuing supply and maintenance remain dependencies.
route_terms.reverse_engineering: Examine delivered hardware, authorized samples or interpretable records with finite local analysis; observed outcomes alone do not reveal all causal or operating conditions.

scope_boundary: A proposed physical or analytical capability. Actual site conditions, finite resources and measured performance determine outcomes. Discovery does not enact land-use restrictions, grant access rights, replace civic labor authority or guarantee safe water or ecosystem recovery.
